basics.name: Piyush D Jadhav
basics.label: Expert Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer at MBition (Mercedes-Benz Group) building the next generation of the "Hey Mercedes" in-cabin virtual assistant, at the intersection of embedded systems and highly optimized edge-AI models. Design Engineering background from IIT Madras combined with hands-on depth in modern C++, software architecture, and embedded Linux across Mercedes-Benz and Dyson. Currently developing and deploying Agentic AI systems — moving beyond command-response models toward proactive, intelligent agents that anticipate user needs.

work.name: Mbition Gmbh
summary: Product leader with a decade of experience shipping consumer and automotive products to millions of users, from defining strategy and roadmap to cross‑functional execution. Track record of translating user needs into technical vision and measurable business impact — across Dyson, Mercedes‑Benz, and early‑stage startups. Design Engineering background (IIT Madras) combined with hands‑on software depth enables bridging user experience, business goals, and technical tradeoffs.

work.name: Dyson Technologies
summary: Responsible for software development of multiple smart consumer electronics products.
